name: @hq/web
description: HQ portal + Worker: workspaces (one repo + its members, roles), sign-in through the shared Supabase project, the inbox (approve, reject, discuss), health board, runs and controls; the API for the iOS app and runners; the MCP server with OAuth 2.1 and workspace tokens; the hourly scheduler

scripts.dev:worker: VITE_EMAIL_SIGNIN=1 vite build --mode development && wrangler dev
scripts.upload-version: vite build && wrangler versions upload --env production
